name: The Drunken Demon Inn, Kitchen
desc1: This large, smelly kitchen is filled with cooking pots and crockery.
desc2: Cooks bustle about at high speed, filling bowls with a thick stew and
desc3: pitchers with ale. A large fat cauldron in the centre of the room is
desc4: filled to the brim with the stew, which it spits and bubbles out all
desc5: over the place. The only exit is to the south.
